column7: the user who activated break-glass can never review their own activation, and an unattributable actor (actorID==0: a machine identity, or an unauthenticated local-CLI invocation) can never record a review at all. ADR-112 keeps activation single-person BECAUSE an independent post-activation review follows it, so a self-review collapses that two-person property into one person. There is no co-approver to also exclude (BreakGlassActivation carries no approver field and ADR-112 rejects two-person break-glass); TestBreakGlassActivation_HasNoApproverField guards that premise so adding co-approval later forces this exclusion to be revisited
